description_en: Queries the details of an instance
name: GetInstanceDetail

AutoReissue.description_en:
Specifies whether automatic hosting is enabled. Valid values:
enable: Enabled.
disable: Disabled
AutoReissue.description_zh:
是否开启自动托管。
enable：开启
disable：未开启

AutoReissueFlag.description_en:
Specifies whether the current version includes automatic hosting. Valid values:
1: Included.
0: Not included
AutoReissueFlag.description_zh:
当前版本是否已包含自动托管：
1：已包含
0：未包含

AverageWaitingTime.description_en: The average waiting time for issuing a certificate of this specification, in seconds
AverageWaitingTime.description_zh: 签发该规格证书平均等待时长，单位秒

Brand.description_en: The CA brand. Valid values: WoSign, CFCA, DigiCert, GeoTrust, GlobalSign, vTrus, and Alibaba

CertIdentifier.description_en:
The global certificate ID. The format is Certificate ID + "-" + Site region ID. This ID is commonly used across Alibaba Cloud services.
For the Chinese site, the format is Certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou".
For the international site, the format is Certificate ID + "-ap-southeast-1".
For example, if the certificate ID is 123, the CertIdentifier for the Chinese site is "123-cn-hangzhou", and for the international site, it is "123-ap-southeast-1"
CertIdentifier.description_zh:
全局证书ID，格式为证书Id + "-" + 站点regionId，常用在阿里云各个云产品中。
  --国内站为证书Id + "-cn-hangzhou"
国际站为证书Id + "-ap-southeast-1"
例如证书Id = 123，则国内站CertIdentifier = “123-cn-hangzhou”，国际站CertIdentifier = "123-ap-southeast-1"

CertificateName.description_en: The name of the instance. When a certificate is issued, this name is used as the default name of the certificate
CertificateName.description_zh: 实例的名称，签发证书时则为作为证书的默认名称

CertificateNotAfter.description_en: The expiration time of the latest certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. If no certificate is issued, this parameter is empty
CertificateNotAfter.description_zh: 最新证书的结束时间，时间戳。未签发证书则为空。精确到秒

CertificateNotBefore.description_en: The start time of the latest certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. If no certificate is issued, this parameter is empty
CertificateNotBefore.description_zh: 最新证书的开始时间，时间戳。未签发证书则为空。精确到秒

CertificateRevokeTime.description_en: The revocation time of the latest certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds
CertificateRevokeTime.description_zh: 最新一张证书吊销时间，时间戳，精确到秒

CertificateStatus.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:
issued: Issued.
revoked: Revoked.
willExpire: Expiring soon.
expired: Expired
CertificateStatus.description_zh:
证书的状态
issued：已签发
revoked：已吊销
willExpire：即将过期
expired：已过期

CertificateType.description_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: DV, OV, and EV

City.description_en: The city where the company or organization of the user who purchased the certificate is located. This field is required when generating a CSR. Default value: Beijing
City.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织所在的城市。生成CSR时需要该字段。默认为Beijing

CompanyId.description_en: The ID of the company information

CountryCode.description_en: The code of the country or region where the organization specified in the certificate is located. For example, CN indicates China, and US indicates the United States. This field is required when generating a CSR. Default value: CN
CountryCode.description_zh: 设置证书组织机构所在国家或地区的代码。例如，CN 表示中国，US 表示美国。生成 CSR 时需要该字段，默认为 CN

Csr.description_en: The certificate signing request in PEM format

DeploymentResourceCount.description_en: The number of deployed cloud service resources

DeploymentUseCount.description_en: The used quota for deployment to cloud servers
DeploymentUseCount.description_zh: 云服务器部署已使用额度

DingGroupList.description_en: The list of associated DingTalk groups for expert services
DingGroupList.description_zh: 关联的专家服务钉钉群列表

items.description_en: The associated DingTalk group for expert services
items.description_zh: 关联的专家服务钉钉群

DingGroupInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the DingTalk group for expert services

DingGroupName.description_en: The name of the DingTalk group for expert services

DingGroupType.description_en:
The type of the DingTalk group for expert services. Valid values:
expedite: Application assistance.
remote: Offline deployment
DingGroupType.description_zh:
专家服务钉钉群类型。
expedite 协助申请
remote 线下部署

DingGroupUrl.description_en: The link to join the DingTalk group for expert services
DingGroupUrl.description_zh: 专家服务钉钉群入群链接

Domain.description_en: The domain name bound to the certificate

DomainValidationList.description_en: The list of domain names to be validated

items.description_en: The domain name to be validated

Cname.description_en: The CNAME record value for verification-free authorization. This parameter may be empty
Cname.description_zh: 免验证授权的Cname记录值。可能返回空

CnameKey.description_en: The prefix used for CNAME validation

Domain.description_en: The domain name to be validated

ValidationType.description_en: The validation type. Valid values: TXT, HTTP, and CNAME

ValidationValue.description_en: The value of the host record for validation

FullDomainCount.description_en: The number of exact domain names

GenerateCsrMethod.description_en:
The method used to generate the CSR. Valid values:
online: Generated by the system. The Csr field is ignored.
upload: Uploaded by the user. The Csr field is required
GenerateCsrMethod.description_zh:
CSR生成方式。
online：系统生成，则会忽略Csr字段。
upload：未开启，用户上传，则要求Csr为必填

InstanceEndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. If no certificate has been issued, this parameter is empty
InstanceEndTime.description_zh: 实例的到期时间，时间戳。如果未签发过证书，则返回空。精确到秒

InstanceStartTime.description_en: The start time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. If no certificate has been issued, this parameter is empty
InstanceStartTime.description_zh: 实例的开始时间，时间戳。如果未签发过证书，则返回空。精确到秒

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the instance. Valid values:
BUY: Official certificate.
TEST: Test certificate
InstanceType.description_zh: 实例类型，BUY：正式证书；TEST：测试证书

KeyAlgorithm.description_en:
The algorithm of the certificate. Valid values:
RSA_2048
RSA_3072
RSA_4096
ECC_256
SM2
KeyAlgorithm.description_zh:
证书算法。
RSA_2048
RSA_3072
RSA_4096
ECC_256
SM2

MonitorExpandFlag.description_en:
Specifies whether the quota for domain name monitoring can be expanded. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No
MonitorExpandFlag.description_zh:
是否可扩容域名监控额度。
1：是
0：否

MonitorUseCount.description_en: The used quota for domain name monitoring

OrderEndTime.description_en: The end time of the instance purchase. The value is a UNIX timestamp used to determine the purchase duration of the instance
OrderEndTime.description_zh: 实例购买时的结束时间，时间戳，用来判断实例的购买时长

OrderStartTime.description_en: The start time of the instance purchase. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds, used to determine the time limit for refunds
OrderStartTime.description_zh: 实例购买时的开始时间，时间戳，用来判断退款时间限制，精确到秒

PendingResult.description_en: The result returned by the CA during the last operation on the certificate
PendingResult.description_zh: 最后一次操作证书时，CA 返回的结果

Province.description_en: The province or region where the company is located. This field is required when generating a CSR. Default value: Beijing
Province.description_zh: 公司所在省份或者地区。生成 CSR 时需要该字段，默认为 Beijing

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Spec.description_en: The specifications of the purchased instance

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
inactive: Pending use.
pending: Under review. The latest certificate is committed for review.
willExpire: Expiring soon.
expired: Expired.
refund: Refunded.
normal: Normal.
closed: Shutdown and unavailable
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。
inactive：待使用
pending：审核中，最新证书提交审核中
willExpire：实例即将过期
expired：实例已经过期
refund：已退款
normal：正常
closed：已关闭，不可使用

TotalDeploymentCount.description_en: The total quota for deployment to cloud servers

TotalMonitorCount.description_en: The total quota for domain name monitoring

UpgradeStatus.description_en:
The upgrade status of the instance. Valid values:
none: The instance is not upgraded.
payed: The instance upgrade is paid.
issued: The latest certificate is issued for the instance upgrade
UpgradeStatus.description_zh:
实例升级状态。

none：实例未升级

payed：实例升级已经付款

issued：实例升级已签发最新证书

ValidationMethod.description_en:
The validation method for the certificate application. Valid values:
DNS: DNS validation, using TXT or CNAME records.
HTTP: File validation
ValidationMethod.description_zh:
申请证书验证方式。
DNS：DNS验证方式，TXT或者CNAME。
HTTP：文件验证方式

VersionType.description_en:
The version type. Valid values:
FOTA: System upgrade.
APP: Application upgrade
VersionType.description_zh: 版本类型。支持：FOTA：系统升级                                 APP：应用升级

WildcardDomainCount.description_en: The number of wildcard domain names
